notes: Cross-verse split with ACT.13.34 and ACT.13.50 over an article governing a substantival adjective the ASV completes with a supplied nominal. Those verses give the nominal to the article under rules 49 and 102; this verse gave *One* to the adjective and left the article unrepresented on rule 20. Rule 20 empties the article's determiner slot only, and rule 54's οἱ ἡμέτεροι -> *our people* keeps the supplied nominal on the article even where another source word has taken the possessive.
